about: Issue 1877: Acid Thorns, the Chorus close-in weapon (rules id tendril: range 1, 2 shots, acid), built in Blender (fx/munition_bodies/chorus_bolt.glb, fx/fx_acid_thorn.gd). The Spitter (the Chorus destroyer that carries it) fires its two thorns at a Directorate destroyer one hex away, as a clip (every frame saved): the gland swells, the thorns fly point first, stick in the plating, acid sheets down and pools, then each thorn crumbles. Run with --part moments --moments res://bench/look_moments_acid_thorn.json. Two more rows (issue 1877, Board Nov 24): a plain bile spine hit on a Directorate and an Eclipse cruiser, held to 8 s after impact, to show the shared Chorus acid mark (now a dark etched burn) on a non-thorn hit and on Eclipse.

rows.label: Acid Thorns (built thorn, sticks then crumbles)
bile spine (not a thorn) on a Directorate cruiser: the new dark etched acid mark
bile spine on an Eclipse cruiser: no lime or green on Eclipse (issue 1693 overlap)
